Wearing a suit and tie makes me feel confident. What do you think?

It’s great to hear that a suit and tie boost your confidence! The way we dress can have a powerful psychological impact—often called the “enclothed cognition” effect. When you put on a garment that signals professionalism, authority, or success, it can actually shift your mindset and make you feel more capable and self-assured. Do you find that the confidence lasts throughout the day, or does it fade after a while? And are there particular situations where the suit feels especially powerful? Knowing more about when and why it works can help you harness that feeling even more effectively.
